notes: Favrit: no pickup-time choice or pre-order for a later day is stated; 'Food truck' appears only as a business-type option in a contact-form dropdown, so focus kept nearest_local. Superb: stored as not relevant because only Go (0 NOK, no online ordering) was priced; its Plus plan does include Online Takeaway with pickup but shows no price, so it is recorded eligible with price_major null. The food-truck line is an English customer testimonial on the homepage. MENU TIGER: a global QR/online-ordering tool with a Norwegian translation and USD-only prices; included because website ordering with takeaway is stated, but a reviewer may prefer to drop it (no explicit 'order ahead / pickup time' sentence, no NOK). SumUp: Norwegian nettbutikk with 'henting i butikk' counted as click-and-collect, but it is a generic web shop (no food wording on the Norwegian pages); the Danish Kvikorder food ordering page exists, no Norwegian equivalent was found in search. No Norwegian food-truck-specific ordering tool with its own site was found: search results were mostly app-store listings, FINN classified ads (an unnamed commission-free takeaway system for food trucks at 450/850 kr/mnd, vendor not named, so not usable) and Wolt. Zettle not checked (enough candidates). One process slip: the Favrit /mobilbestilling and /pris pages were fetched in the same turn early on; all later requests were one at a time.
